p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: each country's official resources
p.espaces.rg_sub: Rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up the up-to-date official sources, then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Support Service (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Card (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health rules that this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: Customs code and duty on imports to the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): verify that a platform is not marked by a regulator before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in its own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understand a document" for a document. For a serious decision, ask a professional person in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Task, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries. 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): Duties and Rules for Nearly Every Country
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duty on import to the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Bill of Lading (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to get reduced duty)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (enterprises importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: health or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: the buyer handles everything from the seller's factory
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the export-declared goods to the buyer's carrier
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads on the ship; thereafter risks and costs are the buyer's
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays freight and insurance until the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Forbidden or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeit products, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such a list is rejected and can be reported (a).
p.espaces.cu_find: Looking for a forwarder or carrier
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly… compare the fees for your country before you send.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn any money from these links: you compare here, then you send with the service you choose.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance Prices Worldwide (World Bank): the actual cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees displayed before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a portable wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total received: fees + exchange rate. A rate worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person will receive it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identity document is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you just met online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when you send.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the actual price, stay within the law
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer. Easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers' country: no counterfeit products, no regulated products without permission.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("wholesale/supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the actual price: product, transport, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment costs and return.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect customers' rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, warranty, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A seller who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrencies.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that will make you rich quickly
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punished.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.

p.papier.sub: Take a picture of a letter, prescription, form or sign: read it in your language.
p.papier.private: The photo remains on your mobile phone. Only the text that is read is sent to the free translation service.
p.papier.first: First time for this language: the phone downloads its read data (a few MB).
p.papier.none: No text found. Take the photo again, flat and with more light.

p.papier.e_read: Read failed. Take that picture again.
p.papier.e_tr: The translation could not be done (connection or daily limit). Try again.
p.papier.warn: Machine translation: for an important document (court, health, money, residence permit), have it checked by someone you trust or an association. Handwriting is often misread.
